title: Expedition Conservatory: controlled trials for batching, KV cache, and quantization portfolio
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a small, reproducible experiment program (the "Conservatory") to validate concrete unit-economics and quality trade-offs for three levers: batching policy changes, KV/prefix caching strategies, and lightweight quantization profiles. Goal is to produce deterministic guidance (configs + guardrails) that can be safely rolled into Dedicated and Hosted plans with measurable cost savings and defined quality SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A/B experiment harness that can run stable comparisons across production-like workload replay within 48 hours
2) Clear throughput and cost delta reporting for each lever (tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and quality regression metrics)
3) Two validated config recipes (one conservative, one aggressive) for each lever with rollout gating tests and automated rollback triggers
4) Operational runbook and dashboard tile in Console showing per-route/ per-model expected savings and risk indicators
milestones: M2: Baseline measurement and hypothesis catalog (due 2026-02-24)
M3: First round trials: batching knob sweep (due 2026-03-05)
M4: KV cache TTL and prefix hit policy trials (due 2026-03-18)
M5: Quantization profile field validation vs quality regressions (due 2026-03-30)
M6: Synthesis, config recipes, and internal review (due 2026-04-12)
M7: Pilot rollout to dedicated capacity cohort and final signoff (due 2026-04-30)
metrics: Secondary: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, request tail latencies > 500ms, end-to-end QA matcher F1 delta
Operational: false-positive rollback triggers per 10k requests, cache hit ratio, batch size distribution
progress_updates: 2026-01-22: Kickoff with Eng (runtime), Observability, and Solutions — scoped initial replay dataset and SLO gating criteria
2026-02-03: Harness skeleton merged (ENG-1984) — replay harness can run 24h of synthetic traffic in 3.5 hours; identified data gaps for long-tail prompt lengths
2026-02-16: Baseline collected for top-30 routes; initial median cost estimate established for control cluster
2026-02-28: Batching sweep completed: medium batch targets (4-8) show 11-18% cost improvement with 3-8% p50 latency increase; documented in results spreadsheet
2026-03-04: KV cache TTL experiments started; early results show hit-ratio sensitivity on short chat sessions — risk of stale context for multi-turn customers

2026-03-09: Quantization candidate profiles (4-bit q8m and bfloat hybrid) evaluated in isolated env — 6% cost reduction with observable quality delta on arithmetic/math prompts; flagged for targeted guardrail tests
review_feedback: Design review (2026-02-05): Console team requests per-route expected savings widget and clearer language about expected quality delta
Security review (2026-02-25): No PII concerns identified for replay dataset but recommended keying with ephemeral dataset IDs
Solutions Engineering (2026-03-01): Ask to include sample migration guide for customers on Dedicated capacity to test conservative configs
Research (2026-03-08): Suggested additional evals on instruction-following prompts to detect hallucination regressions post-quantization
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quality regressions from aggressive quantization profiles — Mitigation: gated A/B with automatic rollback if QA F1 drops > 1.5%
Risk: Multi-tenant KV caching could leak cross-customer state — Mitigation: enforce strict tenant-scoped cache keys and audit logs for cache hits
Risk: Increased tail latency under heavy batching — Mitigation: dynamic batch-size cap and latency SLO guardrail that drops batching for latency-sensitive routes
